text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup had arrived, featuring 
competitors like Zenno Rob Roy and Special 
Week, both making their return to racing 
after some time away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of them are first-rate competitors— 
but that is well within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brushing aside the crowd's worries that 
this would be an uphill battle, Eishin 
Flash boldly challenges her predecessors.
